tool_args.rationale: The six target-horizon observations identify the smooth base but leave the activation law untested. The trajectory batch is the only remaining relevant probe for distinguishing a base-only law from threshold and conjunctive siphons before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Smooth saturating base with sink-gradient attenuation
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It fits all six rows to rounding precision, but that fit cannot distinguish a base-only law from one with a siphon that is inactive in every observed row.
The largest observed gradient is 2.20, below the recalled activation range. The data constrain neither the siphon strength nor whether a second condition is required for activation.
Already acquired. It added a low-gradient point at 0.30 and confirmed the base law without testing siphon activation.
